name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: High-velocity procedural graph featuring active oracle peak-price arbitrage, continuous town shop capture, dynamic seed budgeting, and proactive shed headroom protection.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, and oracle price drop signals.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Blocks capital expenditure and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively fulfills unlocked town shop contracts (Carrots, Tomatoes, Strawberries, Eggs) to lock in 2x-3x price premiums before open market disposal.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing low-margin non-feed inventory at fair prices when shed approaches true capacity.

nodes.name: Oracle Market Timing & Paced Liquidation
nodes.description: Leverages 96-step oracle forecasts and spot prices to systematically monetize harvest surpluses at cyclical price peaks and front-run predicted gluts in paced tranches.

nodes.name: High-Yield Crop & Market Synchronization
nodes.description: Directs seed budgeting and field planting toward high profit-per-hour crops (Strawberries, Tomatoes, Carrots) with strict maturation horizons, restricting wheat to livestock feed.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines (planting, watering, feeding livestock, harvesting) using available action slots.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, redundant HIRE); enforce emergency sales of non-feed inventory at hour >= 20 in sized tranches to meet exact payroll shortfall; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 2); do not liquidate high-multiplier town shop crops to cover minor payroll deficits if non-feed items or surplus wool/fertilizer suffice.

attributes.guidance: Fulfill town shop contract demands (Carrots, Tomatoes, Strawberries, Eggs) immediately to capture 2x-3x price premiums; prioritize shop fulfillment over all open-market sales; synchronize crop planting and worker harvest delivery directly to current and upcoming shop demands.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell wheat needed for livestock feed buffer; do not withhold inventory waiting for future theoretical shops if current shop orders are active and unfulfilled.

attributes.guidance: Evict lowest-margin inventory (fertilizer, surplus wheat above reserve, raw wool) at market price >= 0.60 * base_price in tranches of 10-15 units; cancel stale buy orders to recover order slots; route eligible goods to town shops before generic open-market liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell town shop contract crops or feed wheat below reserve (n_animals * 2); avoid dumping items below 0.50 * base_price; do not wait until shed reaches 95+ where simultaneous worker drop-offs trigger silent inventory loss.

attributes.condition: (oracle_glut_risk >= 0.50 and current_price >= 0.75 * base_price) or (current_price >= 1.10 * base_price and shed_used >= 15) or (current_price >= 1.05 * base_price and shed_used >= 30) or (day >= 28 and shed_used >= 10)
attributes.guidance: Execute sales in paced batches (8-12 units per order) to prevent order book slippage and self-induced price collapse; capture cyclical peaks (>= 1.10x base) at lower shed thresholds (>= 15) to maintain steady cash flow; protect town shop reserves and feed wheat; channel cash toward workforce expansion to reach 10 hands early.
attributes.pitfalls: Never dump large single-turn market orders (> 20 units) that crash market prices; do not sell wheat below animal feed buffer; do not liquidate commodities committed to immediate town shop delivery.

attributes.guidance: Implement early town shop diversification from Day 1: allocate 20-30% of planting capacity to Carrots alongside Strawberries and Tomatoes to continuously capture 2x-3x Town Shop premiums; dynamically size seed purchases to available surplus (net_available_cash - midnight_payroll_due); transition to fast-maturing Carrots and Tomatoes on days 26-28; restrict wheat strictly to sustain animal feed buffer (n_animals * 2).
attributes.pitfalls: Do not plant Strawberries after day 25 or Tomatoes after day 27 as they will not mature before turn 720; cease all planting by day 28 hour 20 to avoid unharvested seed waste; never allocate funds to seeds that compromise the midnight payroll reserve.

attributes.guidance: Recruit hired hands aggressively up to 10 hands whenever net_available_cash safely exceeds midnight payroll plus hire cost; prioritize town shop harvest capturing by harvesting contract-matching mature crops and depositing them into the shed immediately; dispatch remaining hands to watering unwatered plots, clearing weeds, planting queued seeds, and feeding livestock; ensure all workers deposit carried inventory before turn 717.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not leave mature crops unharvested or drying unwatered for consecutive turns; ensure workers drop all carried inventory into the shed before the terminal steps (turn 718-720).
